sources.title: Ollama v0.35 Jev-style decision endpoint (Sep 29)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Ollama added Jev-style decision-model support via /v1/systemone in v0.35 (Sep 28-29): typed choices/probabilities/scores instead of text; ticket triage, model routing, classification.
claims.context: Ollama blog Sep 29, full body read in r4.

claims.text: Nimble (Bespoke Labs, open-source 9B) + Tev1 (Together AI, experimental 4B + 0.8B) pullable at launch; curl + TypeSafe SDK examples documented.
claims.context: Vendor availability statement; release-note mirrors corroborate.

claims.text: Nimble 9B averaged 91ms per decision in Pac-Man example on M5 Max (illustrative, NOT universal); 13 public datasets / 3,880 decisions vs Jev 1.13 (Bespoke run).
Serving interface, NOT a model release; precedes Oct 1 Clef/Decider weights; must not merge benchmarks.

limitations.text: 91ms is single-example illustrative, not universal performance.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
